name: about-us
content:
About Us It's not about us, is it?

Yes, it’s really about you. More than that, our work is about your experience and expression of how we do for you.

Yet, we do have a tiny little story to tell, a peek at who we are. Two things you can already guess: it’s a love story, and it’s about shipping.

We believe our four customer promises set us apart from the rest

1. Happy and you’ll know it

From our online team to our delivery drivers, we’ll make sure our people enjoy what they do. This means they can give you friendliness, enthusiasm and can do attitude you’ve every right to expect.

2. Easy-peasy pricing

We keep our pricing straightforward and you reviews straight talking. Plus we guarantee if system bills you over, we’ll correct it. To be honesty’s our policy and it’s makes us proud.

3. Be fastest is our challenge

From the moment you first visit us and for as long as we’re in touch, we’ll make sure your shipment will be loaded and unloaded from plane first, will pass customs first, will delivered nonstop cause we are use all our recourses during transportation

4. Famously flexible to your needs

Every one is different, with different needs and that’s why we’ll do everything we can to work around you. From instant help with any order in any store, to delivery or opened office 7 days of the week we’re promise to make you happy.
